effective_basis: printed edition date (August 2024). Applicability to TY2026 is UNKNOWN (verify.md s2 #80).
status_note: Edition CONFIRMED for current use (named in RMC 36-2026 item 1). Annex C text is TY2025 only; TY2026 applicability UNKNOWN (verify.md s2 #80). Phase P7; not filled in MVP. Rule set r2 is a thin mapping: accounting measure to crosswalk input key (fill_class input) with lineage. Books holds no rate, election, threshold, applicability test, ATC choice, due date or penalty (ADR-0007).

owner_values.forms: Forms computes or decides it (tax due, rate, ATC, election, applicability, penalties, totals). Books keeps no rule.
owner_values.profile: The Forms taxpayer profile supplies it.
owner_values.identity: Forms sets it from the requested period.
owner_values.user: A person enters it in Forms.
